doc:
### PROPOSAL-14 — Editorial Magazine - **slug**: `editorial` - **Vibe**: High-fashion editorial print — ivory and ink, Didot-style serif display, a single red accent, and generous whitespace. - **Best for**: Product show pages and monthly earnings reports — data presented like a magazine feature. Adjectives: refined, confident, print-like. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#faf8f3` | Ivory paper canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#ffffff` | Card and panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#f3efe6` | Raised/hover paper | | `--border-subtle` | `#e2dccd` | Fine hairline rules | | `--border-default` | `#c4bba8` | Standard print borders | | `--border-focus` | `#c8102e` | Editorial-red focus rule | | `--text-primary` | `#111111` | Ink-black headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#3d3d3d` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#6f6857` | Captions, bylines, fine print | | `--color-action` | `#c8102e` | Editorial-red primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#a50d25` | Action hover (deeper red) | | `--color-earnings` | `#0f6b3a` | Deep-print-green earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#0c5730` | Earnings hover (deeper green) | | `--color-automation` | `#1f3a6e` | Print-navy automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#a86f1f` | Ochre warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#8f1022` | Dark-red destructive states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(200, 16, 46, 0.10)` | Red tint behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(15, 107, 58, 0.10)` | Green tint behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(31, 58, 110, 0.10)` | Navy tint behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Bodoni Moda", "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif` — Didot-style high-contrast serif for KPI numerals and mastheads, 600-800 weight, tight leading. Sans: `"Inter", "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif` for UI labels and body. Mono: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for prices, timestamps, and fine print. Overlines in uppercase sans with `letter-spacing: 0.14em`. - **Radii & Borders**: Sharp — `border-radius: 0`. Borders are hairline 1px rules; the masthead rule under headings is 3-4px. Dividers are thin rules with generous padding above and below. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Sharp rectangles, uppercase sans labels with wide tracking. Primary = red block with white text (AA-large); secondary = hairline-outlined ink; tertiary = text-only with a red underline. Focus = red underline rule. - **Cards**: White with a hairline border, oversized display numeral, small-caps overline, and a thin masthead rule at top; padding is generous (`p-8`+). Hover = subtle paper lift (2px), never a glow. - **Badges/Status**: Small-caps italic labels or a tiny red square bullet; publishing = pulsing red dot; published = deep green dot. - **Tables**: Magazine spread style — hairlines, generous row height, oversized tabular serif numerals; header row in small caps. Row hover = red hairline above/below. - **Forms/Inputs**: Baseline-only fields with a hairline rule; focus = red baseline. Labels in small caps. - **Loading**: An elegant red dot pulse ("stand by"); determinate = a thin hairline progress rule. - **Signature detail**: Oversized Didot-style serif numerals + 3px masthead rules + small-caps overlines floating in whitespace — a print feature, not an app. - **Motion & Animation**: Quiet and print-like — 250ms `ease-in-out`; content reveals with a vertical "press" easing (clip from top). Nothing bounces; hover shifts are almost imperceptible. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
EARNINGS · THIS MONTH $8,240 +22% vs. July 2026
```
